messages:
Sofia Patel: Heads-up — customs flagged a reclassification on manifest MNL-2289 (weight/HS code mismatch). Entire container put on hold. This affects reservation RES-99110 (EU private racks) + marketplace listing MLK-441 (4 racks allocated).
Ben Turner: Wait — HS code mismatch? How did that get through paperwork?
Orion Logistics Rep: Apologies. Export docs were filed with legacy HS code 8471.50, customs is asking for product-level certs and corrected gross weights. They won't release until docs updated. Estimated hold 72-96h unless we re-route to expedited clearance.
Lina Rodriguez: Private customer needs 6 racks by Tues for a feature launch. Marketplace reserved 4 racks for a partner trial. Total impacted: 10 racks.
Tom Hayashi: Can we swap capacity from another marketplace listing? We have MLK-399 with 12 racks in US staging that could be repurposed but needs cross-dock and additional import docs.
Sofia Patel: Two potential mitigations: (A) patch docs + customs brokerage expedite (costly, 48-72h) or (B) temporary marketplace swap: pull 4 racks from MLK-399 -> RES-99110 and then replenish MLK-399 once MNL-2289 clears.
Ben Turner: If we do (B) we must ensure billing/commit changes. MarketplaceOpsBot: Auto-action required: generate swap request SWP-4412, lock SKUs, notify finance for prorate.
Lina Rodriguez: Which SKUs are safe to swap? We need whole racks (rtx-p2-rack). Orion: Available serials at US staging: 7101-7112 (12 racks). We can allocate 4 for cross-region transfer with expedited AWB, ETA to EU DC ~4 days.
Tom Hayashi: Cross-region transfer + customs import will still require import docs on our side. Finance-Bot: Note: cross-region transfer estimate + duties ~1.8x ground import. Confirm chargeback account?
Sofia Patel: Accept higher cost if it meets launch. Requesting Finance sign-off to bill contingency fund. Claire is OOO — pinging @Finance on Slack.
Ben Turner: Operational impact: moving 4 racks reduces US staging buffer. If MNL-2289 clears in 3 days, we replenish MLK-399 from that manifest. Risk: if manifest held >7 days, partner trial for MLK-399 delayed.
Lina Rodriguez: Proposed plan: 1) Swap 4 racks from MLK-399 -> RES-99110 (create SWP-4412) 2) Expedite customs brokerage on MNL-2289 for remaining 6 racks (pay contingency if needed) 3) Update marketplace inventory & billing with prorated credits.
MarketplaceOpsBot: Created SWP-4412. Assigned to Lina Rodriguez and Ben Turner.
Orion Logistics Rep: We'll prep AWB and estimated cross-dock date in 6hrs. Can label as "priority: launch".
Finance-Bot: Pre-approval request posted to finance-approvals. Please attach estimated cost delta.
Sofia Patel: I'll draft the short customer message: "We’re adjusting fulfillment to ensure your launch timeline — four racks will ship from alternate staging and the remainder are being cleared; tracking and any SLA credits will follow." OK to send after Finance pre-approval.
Ben Turner: I'm running a quick inventory reconciliation now and will post serial map in ~15m.
Lina Rodriguez: I'll coordinate docs with Orion and brokerage. If customs lets us amend HS code online, we can avoid AWB and reduce cost.
Tom Hayashi: If customs insists on physical paperwork, escalate to legal for letters of origin.
MarketplaceOpsBot: Reminder: update MLK-399 listing ETA and post partner notification template once swap completes.
Sofia Patel: Great work. Keep updates here; if anyone needs me, DM.
Orion Logistics Rep: Will update manifest status by EOD and confirm AWB numbers. Sorry for the hit — we’ll prioritize the launch-labeled units. :shipit:
